001package io.github.ai4ci.output;
002
003import java.util.stream.Stream;
004
005import org.immutables.value.Value;
006
007import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Outbreak;
008import io.github.ai4ci.flow.output.CSVWriter;
009import io.github.ai4ci.flow.output.Export;
010import io.github.ai4ci.flow.output.Export.Stage;
011
012@Value.Immutable
013@Export(
014                stage = Stage.BASELINE,
015                value = "viral-challenge.csv",
016                size = 64 * 64,
017                selector = ViralChallengeCSV.Selector.class,
018                writer = CSVWriter.class
019)
020public interface ViralChallengeCSV extends CommonCSV.Individual {
021
022        /**
023         * Selector class that implements Export.Selector to provide a stream of
024         * LineListCSV records from an Outbreak simulation for database export.
025         */
026        static class Selector implements Export.Selector {
027                @Override
028                public Stream<ViralChallengeCSV> apply(Outbreak o) {
029
030                        var prof = o.getExecutionConfiguration()
031                                .getViralChallengeProfile();
032                        return prof.stream()
033                                .flatMap(
034                                        i -> i.getStates()
035                                                .stream()
036                                                .map(
037                                                        ihm -> CSVMapper.INSTANCE
038                                                                .toViralChallengeCSV(o, i.getPersonId(), ihm)
039                                                )
040                                );
041
042                }
043        }
044}
